notes.title: Gameplay Update 6/26/23
notes.content:
We've made an update to the standard difficulty of A Token War in an effort to better embrace the more puzzle oriented nature of a lot of the battles.

Previously: losing any battle would consume 1 White Flag. Once you run out of white flags, the next loss resets your progress to the last checkpoint. 

After this update: You can only lose a maximum of 1 White Flag per battle, meaning that the FIRST time you lose a particular battle you will use up a White Flag, but unsuccessful subsequent attempts will not.

This change does not impact True Strategist difficulty.

**This change will only take effect after the next loss on a battle for current campaigns, previous losses were not tracked so any in-progress campaigns can still lose one flag on a battle they have been stuck on. 

The primary goal of this change is to allow players to spend time trying to figure out how to take on a given challenge, without being too punishing for failed attempts. The battles in a A Token War often feel more like puzzles, where the key to winning is figuring out the correct strategy rather than assembling the perfect army. Hopefully players will find that the new flag system allows them to experience the game more fully while still being challenging.

notes.title: Small stabilization patch
notes.content: Bug fixes for potential inconsistency in saving and loading, updating data scheme.

notes.title: A Token War - Versus Mode Patch - 8/2/2021
notes.content:
A small patch for versus mode focused on bug fixing.

1.) Players can no longer place more that one Stronghold when in a versus match. Previously this would result in an invalid setup state, however, passing the turn could lock the invalid state and cause a whole host of problems.

2.) Fixed a bug where spells in versus matches would sometimes think they belonged to the opposite player, either preventing them from being cast at all or only showing valid targets for the opponent.

notes.title: New Tokens!
notes.content:
With this update we're introducing a powerful new Structure and Stronghold upgrade to help with your conquest.

New Structure
Medical Tent - A powerful Structure which will help your Units outlast the opponent

New Upgrade
Slapdash - For those who may suffer more damage than they wish in battle, Slapdash can help by repairing your Stronghold for 2 health after every victory.

notes.title: A Token War - Balance Update 7-5-2021
notes.content:
Balance Update

As part of our ongoing effort to address game balance, this update focuses on making the early game more approachable and forgiving.


 Changed Stronghold type from "Manor House" to "Homestead" on the "Funnel of Doom" level.
 Removed enemy Unit space from "The Hill Fort."
 Increased player power limit on "The Forest Gates."
 Added additional checkpoints to the middle of Zones 2, 3, and 4.
 Player now receives repairs after completing intermediate checkpoints.

notes.title: A Token War - Patch Notes 6/21/2021
notes.content: Includes minor bug fixes and a larger change to utilize GPU based particle systems in some cases. This change should increase rendering performance significantly on some devices, as well as visual fidelity.

notes.title: Balance Update - 5/19/21
notes.content:
A new update for A token War is now live! This patch focuses on small balance changes as we continue to respond to player feedback about the difficulty of the game, as well as minor bug fixes.

Balance Changes

 Added extra Iconic Battle to the end of Zone 1. This change will only take effect for new games, existing campaigns will not be reset to this Iconic Battle on a loss due to how the checkpointing system works.
 Players now earn a White Flag upon completion of a zone. This should give a little more room for mistakes
 White flag cost reduction from 300 to 250. Often choosing to buy an extra White Flag never quite seemed worth it, this price reduction should help enable players to feel more comfortable purchasing extra flags when needed
 Excess white flags now saved after Iconic Battles. Instead of always restarting from an Iconic Battle with 3 White Flags, players will now restart with either 3, or the number of flags they had after completing the Iconic battle, whichever is larger. This should allow for a few more chances at some tough battles when combined with the new White Flag rewards at the end of zones.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a typo in the story text which is presented part way through the Pirate / Water Zone.


If you want to discuss any of these changes or offer suggestions for future improvements, feel free to head on over to our Discord: http://discord.gg/VurN8wHHpy

notes.title: A Token War - Features + Optimization - 5/12/21
notes.content:
This patch includes a couple changes in response to community suggestions for feature enhancements, as well as an optimization pass to increase performance and framerate.

New Features

When hovering over rewards, keywords will now have explanations pop up after a few seconds, just like in battle. This change is a direct result of community suggestions on the Community Hub.

The Settings menu now includes a toggle for displaying tips. When turned on, the game plays as before, when this toggle is unchecked there will be no how to play tips displayed in game except in the Training Grounds. This change speeds up the process of starting a new game for experienced players. Story text is still displayed.

Optimization

Small general optimization to increase framerate in all scenarios.

More targeted optimization pass to significantly improve performance in battle, should give noticeable performance improvements when in battle.

notes.title: A Token War - Patch Notes 5/3/21
notes.content:
This update contains small balance and quality of life changes for A Token War based on early player feedback.

Notes: A Token War is designed to be challenging, however a number of players were finding the early levels more challenging than intended. The balance changes are designed to make the first two zones a bit less difficult while still maintaining a decent challenge level overall.

Balance

 Slightly reduced enemy power level on Hill Fort (zone 1, battle 5) by replacing the Big Grunt in that battle with a Court Wizard.
 Reduced overall AI power level on several battles in zone 2. This should bring the average power of enemy configurations down to a slightly more manageable level.


Quality of Life

 Changed dynamic text scaling and panel size of Upgrades to player Stronghold for readability.
 Added more drop shadows to some elements for better contrast and visibility.

notes.title: A Token War is Out Now!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to announce that A Token War is now fully released and available on our Steam page! It’s been a long journey to get here and we couldn’t be more happy with the result. We wanted to again thank everyone who helped us get here and we hope you enjoy playing A Token War as much as we enjoyed making it!

Here are a few things we wanted to address with the launch -

Resources
Check out our getting started video series for tips on strategy and building your collection. You can also read our getting started guide in the Community Hub!

Why no early access?
It’s a fairly common practice these days to have a somewhat extended early access phase for new games, rather than a full release. We decided to forego early access primarily because we believe that after a closed beta, A Token War is ready! For games on a larger scale, early access can help iron out a lot of details. For a much tighter experience like A Token War, however, early access can sometimes stretch on a bit too long without a lot of benefit.

What about updates? Will the game be actively Updated?
Yes! We will continue to actively update and improve A Token War based on user feedback.

What about DLC?
For now, we plan to focus on the core game, with our updates and new features being free. However, that doesn’t mean there won’t be any larger expansions in the future which would be available as DLC.

Leave a Review!
This isn’t a question, but if you play A Token War and you enjoy it, leaving a review is both extremely helpful for us and for allowing prospective players to discover the game.

Socials
We have a Discord server setup for A token War if you want to stop by and chat, you can also follow us on Twitter for updates and announcements.

notes.title: A Token War - Full Release April 28th
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that A Token War will be launching on April 28th! We can't wait to share the game with you and we hope you love it. We also want to thank everyone who helped make this release possible, we couldn't have brought A Token War to life without the support of our Beta testers and early reviewers.

Join Us on Discord
We have set up a Discord server for A Token War where you can hang out and talk about the game, asks some questions or just lurk. We plan to run community events largely through the Discord server so please stop by and say hi!

Share Your Content
On April 28th, if you play A Token War and you have a good experience you can help us out a lot by leaving a review on the store page. We greatly appreciate it and you can help others find the game if they're interested. You can also share your screenshots or other game related content on our Steam Community Page.

Thank you all again, we hope to see you on the battlefield!
